title: Fixed Indexed Annuities — Surrender Charge Schedule by Tier
content:
## Contract data page: surrender charge schedule

Each Ashgrove Fixed Indexed Annuities tier carries a surrender charge schedule of fixed length. The schedule states one surrender charge percentage for each contract year of the schedule, in order from contract year 1. Contract years and contract anniversaries are counted from the issue date shown on the contract.

| Tier | Schedule length (contract years) |
|---|---|
| Ashgrove IndexEdge 5 | 5 |
| Ashgrove IndexEdge 7 | 7 |
| Ashgrove IndexEdge 10 | 10 |
| Ashgrove IndexEdge 10 Bonus | 10 |
| Ashgrove IncomeShield 7 | 7 |
| Ashgrove IncomeShield 10 | 10 |

### Percentage by contract year

| Contract year | IndexEdge 5 | IndexEdge 7 | IndexEdge 10 | IndexEdge 10 Bonus | IncomeShield 7 | IncomeShield 10 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 8% | 9% | 10% | 10% | 9% | 10% |
| 2 | 7% | 8% | 9% | 9% | 8% | 9% |
| 3 | 6% | 7% | 8% | 8% | 7% | 8% |
| 4 | 5% | 6% | 7% | 7% | 6% | 7% |
| 5 | 4% | 5% | 6% | 6% | 5% | 6% |
| 6 | — | 4% | 5% | 5% | 4% | 5% |
| 7 | — | 3% | 4% | 4% | 3% | 4% |
| 8 | — | — | 3% | 3% | — | 3% |
| 9 | — | — | 2% | 2% | — | 2% |
| 10 | — | — | 1% | 1% | — | 1% |

A dash marks a contract year beyond the end of that tier's schedule; the schedule lists no percentage for it.

### Payment deferral on surrender

On every tier, Ashgrove may defer payment of a surrender for up to 180 calendar days.

| Tier | Longest surrender payment deferral |
|---|---|
| All six tiers | 180 calendar days |

### Reading the schedule (hypothetical lookups)

- *An Ashgrove IndexEdge 7 contract in its fourth contract year:* the row for contract year 4 gives 6%.
- *An Ashgrove IncomeShield 10 contract in its ninth contract year:* the row for contract year 9 gives 2%.
- *An Ashgrove IndexEdge 5 contract in its sixth contract year:* the five-year schedule has ended, and the table lists no percentage for that year.

The IndexEdge 10, IndexEdge 10 Bonus and IncomeShield 10 tiers share one ten-year scale; the IndexEdge 7 and IncomeShield 7 tiers share one seven-year scale.
